regime.label: Short-gamma breakout below the 1100 flip after a +13.6 thrust cleared the 1080 call wall
evidence: 1085.2 spot sits below the 1100 gamma flip (cumulative net GEX turns positive only above 1100), so dealers are net short gamma between spot and 1100 and hedge with the move.
13.6-point up day (+1.27%) cleared the 1080 call wall (2,303 OI) on 210 lots; the next cap is the 1100 call wall (2,101 OI, live 312 vol).
12.5% ATM IV is the lowest in 7 sessions and fell on an up day, making long gamma cheap while a 1100 break can force a dealer chase.
1050 near-put wall (1,598 OI, 452 live vol) is the working support; max pain 1070 sits 15 points below spot.

S50U26.today_summary: 1085.2 anchor jumped 13.6 points (+1.27%), clearing the 1080 call wall (2,303 OI) and pulling 15 points above the 1070 max-pain anchor. Put flow dominated at a 2.07 P/C volume ratio, but on an up day the 3,244 put lots read as selling/rolling into strength (552 vol rolling off 1010, 452 building the 1050 support) rather than fresh downside bets. ATM IV compressed to 12.5%, the lowest in seven sessions, so optionality is cheap even as spot approaches the 1100 gamma flip. Near-ATM skew is call-rich (1090 call 14.4% vs put 10.7%), confirming an upside chase.
what_changed: Spot broke a week-long 1077-1081 range: +13.6 to 1085.2 after a 1071.7 dip on 08-14, first close above the 1080 call wall.
P/C volume spiked to 2.07 from 0.85 (put vol 3,244), the heaviest put flow in the window, concentrated in support-building/roll strikes (1050, 1010).
ATM IV ground down to 12.5% from 13.5% on 08-07, cheapening gamma into the move.
Put OI grew to 32,232 from 29,388 on 08-07 (+9.7%); near-put support migrated up toward the 1050 strike.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Max pain has been welded to 1070 for the entire seven-session window (08-07 through 08-17) while spot chopped 1077-1081, dipped to 1071.7 on 08-14, then gapped 13.6 points to 1085.2 — the first decisive break above the 1070 anchor and the 1080 call wall. Put OI built steadily (+9.7% to 32,232) yet ATM IV fell about a full point (13.5% to 12.5%), a calm melt-up in which dealers refused to pay up for gamma. The dominant burden map is a call-OI cap at 1080/1090/1100 and put support migrating up to 1050, with the 910 put wall (12,319 OI) purely structural and stale. GEX flipped the near-money 1080-1100 strikes positive while the cumulative profile stays short-gamma up to the ~1100 flip, so the +13.6 thrust can extend if 1100 breaks. With 43 DTE and cash settlement, the 1070 max-pain magnet is weak this far out — this is a breakout-test regime, not a pin.

strategies.name: Bull call spread 1090C / 1110C
strategies.rationale: Spot at 1085 is short-gamma below the 1100 flip; a break of the 1100 call wall forces dealer buying that can run toward 1110-1120, and 12.5% compressed IV makes the debit cheap.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit ~7.9 points (16.9 - 9.0); max gain ~12.1 points at/above 1110.
strategies.invalidation: A sustained trade back below the 1080 call wall — the breakout premise fails and spot re-magnetizes to 1070 max pain.

strategies.name: Bear call spread 1100C / 1120C
strategies.rationale: The mirror case: the 1100 call wall (2,101 OI, live 312 vol) is a long-gamma cap, so if the rally stalls there dealers dampen and price mean-reverts toward 1080/1070.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = wing width 20 - net credit ~6.0 = ~14 points; max gain ~6.0 points below 1100.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1100 that holds — the gamma flip turns dealers to a chase and this position loses.

strategies.name: Put credit spread 1050P / 1030P
strategies.rationale: Sells the live 1050 near-put wall (1,598 OI, 452 vol) that is building support, with the 1070 max-pain anchor sitting above it; note the 12.5% compressed IV makes the credit thin and the payoff negative-skew, so size small.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = wing width 20 - net credit ~3.1 = ~16.9 points; max gain ~3.1 points above 1050.
strategies.invalidation: Spot closing below 1050 — the put shelf fails and downside momentum overtakes the support.

S50U26.prediction: Base case: spot oscillates 1080-1100 between the cleared 1080 call wall and the 1100 gamma flip, with a 1-sigma daily range of about 8.6 points. A close above 1100 opens 1110-1120 as short-gamma dealers chase the move; a close back below 1070 re-establishes the max-pain magnet. The 1100 flip is the single decision line that flips the regime from mean-reverting cap to momentum chase.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only — never trade advice, and defined-risk max loss is real, not risk-free. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, so there is no physical delivery and pinning/max-pain gravity is a tendency, not a guarantee — and it is especially weak here at 43 DTE, so the 1070 anchor should not be treated as a target.
